description: Localytics-style mobile marketing raw event stream for a churn prediction service. Candidates engineer RFM (Recency, Frequency, Monetary) features from these events; those features become training data.
as_of_note: Use this observation timestamp when computing recency and lookback windows (e.g. last 30 / 90 days).

dataset.description: Single sample file of raw events only. No precomputed features or separate customer table.

fields.event_type: session | purchase | push_sent | push_open | in_app_event | campaign_click | support_ticket

feature_engineering_expectation.required: Engineer RFM features from raw events: Recency, Frequency, Monetary. Use as_of_timestamp for windows.

suggested_rfm.recency: Days since last meaningful activity (e.g. last session) relative to as_of_timestamp
suggested_rfm.frequency: Count of sessions (or equivalent activity) in chosen lookback windows (e.g. 30d / 90d)
suggested_rfm.monetary: Purchase count and/or revenue in a chosen lookback window (e.g. 90d)

feature_engineering_expectation.optional: You may add engagement-derived features (push open rate, campaign clicks, support volume, etc.) if you justify them.

notes: Raw events only; pre-aggregated feature tables are intentionally not provided.
Feature engineering (raw events -> RFM training table) is part of the assignment.
